"""RoboTwin limited-mode client attempt for place_a2b_left.

No reset or motion command is issued until the service has connected and an
observation is available. The recorded run could not proceed because the
service did not accept a connection.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

from rcb_client import Robot


OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    # Robot() waits for the service's warm-up and connects through the
    # documented rcb-limited client. There are deliberately no reset calls.
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))

    # Read-only initial observation. No command is submitted without a live
    # episode and a camera view from which to identify A and B.
    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
    (OUT / "initial_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    from PIL import Image

    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"initial_{camera}.png")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
